_comment: T-16 FRED copyright scan. Three classes (FRED legal, read 2026-10-21): public-domain -> public; citation-required (copyrightNotice=true) -> display-permitted WITH "Source: publisher via FRED" attribution; pre-approval (license contains 'pre-approval') -> private-only, no fetch, no display until the publisher's permission is recorded (D-44, 2026-10-24). Re-run the scan when a series is added.
